notes.channels: name → id, for channels slack_search_channels cannot find. A private channel where the Slack app is not a member never comes back from search even though YOU are in it — take the id from the channel URL (…/archives/<ID>) and put it here once.
notes.standup_time_kyiv: when your standup happens. The default brief window is `previous_standup_day standup_time → today standup_time`, so it covers work done after yesterday's meeting AND this morning's work before today's.
notes.slack.workspace: the <workspace> in <workspace>.slack.com — used to build message permalinks.
notes.slack.bot_token_keychain_item: macOS Keychain item holding the bot token (account = $USER). Create the Slack app yourself; it needs chat:write. See README.
notes.tracker: the issue tracker read over MCP. `web` is the issue-link base (<web>/issues/<number>); `user_email` is how the skill finds your tracker user id when the tracker has no whoami tool.
notes.github.baseline_repos: repos to check for Actions runs even in windows where you pushed no commits — a deploy you triggered, a nightly you care about.
